name: entra
_status: TEMPLATE, UNTESTED: built from Microsoft documentation, never run against a tenant.
notes: Step-up uses a Conditional Access authentication context (C1..C99) requested with the `claims` parameter, not acr_values. The id must match a context created in the tenant (docs advise not hard-coding it).
The token carries the satisfied contexts in the optional `acrs` claim (array); the resource must opt in to the optional claim.
The API challenge is the Entra claims challenge: error="insufficient_claims" with a base64 `claims` value and cc_type="authcontext".

The cited pages do not document max_age or an auth_time guarantee for this flow. Freshness is normally governed by the sign-in frequency control of the Conditional Access policy. emitsAuthTime is therefore false, so the API REFUSES to start with a max-age policy (see docs/idp-adapter.md, freshness problem).
